article.title: DomoAI推出InkoAI Agent，影片可逐步審稿
article.summary: DomoAI表示，InkoAI Agent可在同一對話管理短片的劇本、角色及鏡頭，並在生成前請創作者確認。
highlights: 現有流程包括短劇、動畫和一般故事。
從商品連結或相片製作影片廣告仍屬計劃。
article.why: 社交內容團隊可在進入後期前，分別核對劇本、角色和鏡頭的品牌要求。
article.next_step: 用已授權素材試做一段短片，逐步記錄審稿、修改和輸出的工序。
article.detail: DomoAI公布InkoAI Agent已可使用，並列出短劇、動畫及一般故事等製作流程。創作者可在同一對話提供文字、圖片或其他參考素材，並審批劇本、角色與鏡頭。公司把商品連結或相片直接生成影片廣告列為後續計劃。測試時宜先確認素材授權和品牌審批安排。
article.title_en: DomoAI launches InkoAI Agent with staged video approvals
article.summary_en: DomoAI says InkoAI Agent can manage scripts, characters and shots in one conversation and seek creator approval before generating.
highlights_en: Current workflows include short drama, animation and general storytelling.
Video ad generation from a product link or photo is still planned.
article.why_en: Social teams can check brand requirements for scripts, characters and shots before post-production.
article.next_step_en: Try one short clip with cleared assets and track review, revision and export steps.
article.detail_en: DomoAI announced that InkoAI Agent is available with workflows for short drama, animation and general stories. Creators can supply text, images and other reference material in the same conversation and approve scripts, characters and shots. The company lists video ads from product links or photos as a future workflow. Confirm asset rights and brand approvals before testing.
